artists.biography: 1) Alt from Turkey 2) ALT from mostly Ireland 3) ALT from Japan 1) Alt is an alternative rock band founded 2000 in Istanbul, Turkey. The band consists of vocalist and guitarist Orkun Tuzel, guitarist Okan Sargin, bassist Kadir Keskin and drummer Sertan Sogukpinar. Alt currently have two releases: Ac Kanatlarini, a demo from 2002, and Ikinci Donem, a web-only release from 2005. Official homepage 2) ALT is also the name of a mostly Irish (Tim is from New Zealand) supergroup composed of Andy White (a solo artist), Liam O'Maonlai (of Hothouse Flowers) and Tim Finn (of Split Enz, Crowded House for one album and The Finn Brothers). They released 2 albums - "Altitude" and a live album simply called "Bootleg". ALT tracks also appear on Tim Finn's "Before and After" (Many's The Time) and some releases of Andy White's "Rare" (Blue You). A re-recording of "What You've Done" was also released on Tim Finn's "Feeding The Gods" - and even became and EP. http://www.andywhite.com/alt/ 3) ALT was formed 2005 in Tokyo. They play post-rock electronica with two vocalists, MC3 people, piano, bass, guitar, laptop and video, the band rather call themself a "creative collective" than a band. http://www.myspace.com/alttokyo Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Altitude" by ALT is a collaborative album originally released in 1995, blending genres such as rock, pop, folk, world, and country. The project features an ad hoc trio including Andy White and others, coming together in Dublin to create a sound that is both eclectic and rooted in singer-songwriter traditions. Musically, the album combines folk rock sensibilities with diverse influences, reflecting a rich tapestry of acoustic textures and melodic songwriting.

This album holds a distinctive place in the artists' discographies as a unique collaboration rather than a solo effort, showcasing a synthesis of their individual styles into a cohesive whole. In 2022, "Altitude" was remastered and reissued by Needle Mythology, a label founded by music writer and broadcaster Pete Paphides, bringing renewed attention to the album with a deluxe edition that highlights its enduring appeal. While specific details on its initial commercial reception are limited, the reissue's critical framing emphasizes the album's artistic significance and the quality of its songwriting and production.
